primaryRuntime: Cloudflare Workers + D1 (free tier, within platform limits)
defaultClient: Browser on desktop, tablet and mobile; no installer or local server on merchant device
explanation: Full 56 capability list is historical desktop parity, not the delivery gate for the hosted web SaaS. Only explicitly deferred desktop/LAN items are excluded from the primary SaaS backlog.

deferredCapabilityIds.reason: Desktop Windows local-first installer and local host lifecycle; SaaS requires browser access, not installation.
Mobile UX via the local HTTPS LAN server, not responsive mobile browser/PWA access to hosted SaaS.
Local server and terminal installer/distribution profiles are optional self-hosted deployments, not hosted SaaS requirements.

releasePolicy: Hosted SaaS readiness depends on user-facing browser flows, tenant isolation, canonical API/DB, security, mobile responsive QA, backups and operated deployment; never force 56/56 desktop equivalence before SaaS launch.
note: R2 software already merged is preserved; the scope overlay does not erase or change canonical desktop status.
